en.answer: In that case, 2 Spell Counters are placed on <<12001>>.
en.question: If 2 monsters are destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of <<4342>>, how many Spell Counters are placed on <<12001>> by its effect?
en.title: If 2 monsters are destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of <<4342>>, how many Spell Counters are placed on <<12001>> by its effect?

ja.answer: 2体のモンスターが「<<4342>>」の効果によって破壊され墓地へ送られたのであれば、「<<12001>>」に魔力カウンターは2つ置かれる事になります。
